tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the sidebar. A warm off-white in light mode, a neutral slightly warm dark in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs and inputs. In dark mode one step above the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table heads, date rows, section and group header rows, neutral pills, the segmented track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and buttons, and the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, currency codes, inactive tabs and placeholder text on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, the dark-mode card outline, the meter track and chart grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outline buttons, chips and the segmented chosen segment. Soft by design: the control is also told apart by its shape and label.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, search and date fields: the lightest warm grey that reaches 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The orange accent: the active tab underline, the logo mark, today in the calendar and goal meters. A fill or a line, never text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view, of a chosen chip and the focus ring. Darkened from the brand orange until white text passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary, in weight 600.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Income, gains and money left: text on positive-soft and on surface.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the available pill: positive at 12% over surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Close to the limit or underfunded: text on warning-soft and on surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the warning pill.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Expenses in stat cards, overspent, losses and field errors: text on negative-soft and on surface.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the overspent pill: negative at 12% over surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Quiet text links such as "View all", on surface.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Phone top bar and tab bar, with a 20px blur. Content scrolls under it. Text on it is ink, never ink-muted.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheets, with a 30px blur. Thicker than glass so form fields stay easy to read.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a dialog or a sheet.

tokens.name: sec-1
tokens.usage: First section (for example Needs): its dot, chart marks and Sankey bands. Blue. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-2
tokens.usage: Second section (Wants). Amber. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-3
tokens.usage: Third section (Savings). Magenta. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-4
tokens.usage: Fourth section (for example Zakat). Indigo. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-5
tokens.usage: Fifth section. Green. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-6
tokens.usage: Sixth section. Orange. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-7
tokens.usage: Seventh section, and the net worth line and the Sankey sources. Teal. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-8
tokens.usage: Eighth section. Purple. A ninth folds into Other, drawn in ink-muted. Never text.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: The page title in the top bar. One per page.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Section names in the budget table, pocket names, payees.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Running text, row names, input text.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Notes under a row, hints, converted amounts. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Section and column labels: uppercase, in ink-muted.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every amount in a row or a table. Tabular figures, right-aligned.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: The stat figure: a stat card or a month total.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure of a page, such as net worth.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control or between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card gap, horizontal padding of rows and the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding and dialog padding. Cards pad 20px (1.25rem).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large gaps in diagrams.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a page title on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, tag pills, avatars and dots only. Never a button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tables. Light mode: a very soft shadow, no border. Dark mode: a 1px line, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only.
